# Shrub craft
This mod just adds legacy console edition shrubs to the game! That's just it...


<details>
<summary>Notes</summary>

 - I personally recomend using Legacy4j with this too just to make it more authentic!
 - Kinda really pointless. Just another shrub!

</details>

## Disclaimer!
I made this mod then realized that Legacy4j has a built in one! It's okay just use it if not using that mod!
